title: openai-compat: support Responses v1 variants + seed/determinism + metadata passthrough
author: Priya Natarajan
description:
Motivation: several customers and internal SDKs expect parity with the OpenAI Responses API surface (variants, seed/determinism toggles, and arbitrary metadata passthrough). This PR adds compatibility plumbing and translation for Responses v1 variants, exposes a deterministic seeding path (seed + temperature semantics mapping), and ensures user-provided metadata from OpenAI-style requests is preserved end-to-end on Redwood requests and emitted in response headers and audit logs.

What this changes: a) API layer: new request translator that recognizes OpenAI `responses` payload variants (including `response_format`/`modalities` shims), b) seed/determinism: translate `seed` to deterministic KV-cache behavior + stable sampling override (maps to deterministic sampler when temperature==0 and seed present; otherwise seed used to initialize RNG for reproducible sampling runs), c) metadata passthrough: carry `metadata` and `top_level` fields into internal request.metadata and into audit-log entries / response _openai_metadata header.

Compatibility notes: the translator is additive and guarded behind the compatibility flag `openai_responses_compat=true` (enabled by default for Hosted API v2). Existing Redwood clients are unaffected. Special care taken to preserve streaming semantics: compatibility layer expands streaming event types (choice.delta, choice.finish) to Redwood's streaming envelope without extra round trips.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement request translator for Responses variants
- [x] Implement seed/determinism mapping and deterministic sampler tests
- [x] Ensure metadata flows to audit logs and response headers
- [x] Add unit + integration tests for streaming conversions
- [x] Update SDK compatibility tests (python/typescript)

Related: ENG-1423 (Responses compatibility), ENG-1450 (determinism/seed behavior), internal RFC: docs/rfcs/openai-compat-responses.md

Notes on rollout: feature gated and configurable per-tenant; default enabled for experiments and new signups. This was tested against the openai-compat test harness and a subset of downstream integrations (redwood-sdk-python quickstarts).

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Overall design looks good. A few nits: please add an integration test that streams a mix of choice.delta and choice.finish events and assert the client-side envelope reconstruction is identical to the legacy OpenAI stream.

Priya Natarajan: Added additional streaming integration test (sdk/python/tests/test_openai_stream_reconstruction.py) and wired it into CI. Also updated stream_mapper to handle nested special tokens in choice.delta.

Diego Ramirez: The deterministic sampler looks promising. Question: when seed is provided but temperature > 0, should we still guarantee reproducibility across runs? Recommend documenting exact guarantees in RFC and in runtime comments.

Priya Natarajan: We map seed+temperature to RNG seed initialization. Deterministic guarantees are best-effort when temperature > 0 (documented). Only when temperature==0 do we fall into sampler mode that bypasses stochastic sampling entirely. Added RFC note and unit tests covering both paths.
Ava Chen: CI flaked on lint in the first run (gofmt/golangci-lint). After rebase and run, lint passes. Approving changes.
release_notes: Add OpenAI Responses API compatibility: variants translation, seed/determinism mapping, and metadata passthrough. Backwards-compatible and feature-gated. SDK test updates included.
